name: Ferienhaus Osterauer
beschreibung:
Situated in the picturesque festival village of Erl at the foot of the Kranzhorn, Ferienhaus Osterauer welcomes guests with a warm ambiance and attentive care. The lovingly equipped accommodations provide a tranquil base for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts.

In addition to the famed Tyrol Festival Erl, guests can enjoy scenic hikes to the Blaubergalm, riverside cycling along the Inn, and day trips to Kufstein.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Osterauer in Erl offers peaceful holiday lodgings in the renowned festival village of Kufsteinerland.
